title: Taal Volcano emits steam laden plumes 1,100 meters high Sunday

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – The main crater of Taal Volcano in Batangas produced a “moderate emission” of steam-laden plumes that rose 1,100 meters above Taal Volcano Island (TVI) over the past 24 hours, the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) reported on Sunday, Sept. 20. In its morning bulletin, Phivolcs said Taal has been emitting an average of 183 metric tons of sulfur dioxide (SO₂) daily since Sept. 17. The plumes drifted southwest. The plume height has increased over the past three days, from 600 meters on Thursday to 700 meters on both Friday and Saturday, before reaching 1,100 meters on […]...
